issue.body:
### What happened?

This is blocking WebGPU push constant emulation (needed for real programs like posenet). cc @benvanik 

Original investigation [here on Discord](https://discord.com/channels/689900678990135345/867052513935753277/1042189916311928943)

When I tried to change https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/c1a2645da619fe517376617fcd3ec94c2624fd27/compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/WGSL/WGSLReplacePushConstants.cpp#L138-L143 to `IREE::HAL::DescriptorType::UniformBuffer`, I'm still seeing spvasm like
```
%__resource_var_3_0_ = OpVariable %_ptr_StorageBuffer__struct_8 StorageBuffer
```
and WGSL like
```glsl
@binding(0) @group(3) var<storage, read_write> x__resource_var_3_0_ : S;
```

(we expect those to be 'uniform', not 'storage')

### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Try to compile a program with `    %0 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c1) : !flow.dispatch.tensor<readonly:tensor<2xi32>>` (e.g. a WebGPU program with push constants, and the change mentioned above)
2. Observe that the generated shaders are using StorageBuffer instead of UniformBuffer

### What component(s) does this issue relate to?

_No response_

### Version information

I'm working off of the `webgpu` branch (https://github.com/iree-org/iree/commit/94f71d54af847cd118911479dfe812560aac1f98), but I think this also happens at tip of tree (e.g. https://github.com/iree-org/iree/commit/a7140200ebd67e4d621f96b40253cd0dab9c454c)

### Additional context

This code doesn't appear to be using `subspanOp.getDescriptorType()`: https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/bdc6cf080b530f3ee65e46c5b9c383e747a4dd53/compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/SPIRV/ConvertToSPIRVPass.cpp#L114-L120

---

I traced through compilation to see where this information is lost:

Before `iree-codegen-iree-comprehensive-bufferize`:
```mlir
    %0 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c1) : !flow.dispatch.tensor<readonly:tensor<2xi32>>
```
After `iree-codegen-iree-comprehensive-bufferize`:
```
    %0 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c1) : memref<2xi32>
    %1 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c1) : !flow.dispatch.tensor<readonly:tensor<2xi32>>
```
Before `map-memref-spirv-storage-class`:
```mlir
    %2 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c0) : memref<?xi32>{%c2}
```
After `map-memref-spirv-storage-class`:
```mlir
    %2 = hal.interface.binding.subspan set(3) binding(0) type(uniform_buffer) offset(%c0) : memref<?xi32, #spirv.storage_class<StorageBuffer>>{%c2}
```

issue.body:
This commit converts HAL::DescriptorTypeAttr to be a proper attribute, with its own attribute storage; so not an IntegerAttr derived one anymore. This is in preparation to be used as MemRef "memory space".

Along the way fixed an issue in `walkAttributeStorage` where we aren't guard against unknown custom attributes--it will just be silently ignored, as the functor won't be called at all so `anyFailed` won't be updated. Additionally check the status of `walkAttributeStorage`.

Progress towards #11183

```
The buffer type in the shader (BufferBindingType::Storage) is not compatible with the type in the layout (BufferBindingType::Uniform).

```

issue.body:
### What happened?

I'm continuing work to get real programs running on WebGPU, and this follows https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/11183.

Our push constant emulation code for WebGPU uses Uniform buffers, but up until now we've only supported Storage buffers. When trying to use uniform buffers I see this error from Tint:
```
Tint reported 1 error(s) for a SPIR-V program, see diagnostics:
error: line:38: For Vulkan, an OpTypeStruct variable containing an OpTypeRuntimeArray must be decorated with BufferBlock if it has storage class Uniform.
  %__resource_var_3_0_ = OpVariable %_ptr_Uniform__struct_8 Uniform
```

I see the same error for posenet and resnet50, in any executable (shader) that uses our push constant emulation.

### Steps to reproduce your issue

1. Use my [`webgpu-uniform-storage-debug` branch](https://github.com/ScottTodd/iree/tree/webgpu-uniform-storage-debug), or https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/11227 and this diff:
    ```diff
    --- a/compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/WGSL/WGSLReplacePushConstants.cpp
    +++ b/compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/WGSL/WGSLReplacePushConstants.cpp
    @@ -139,7 +139,7 @@ class WGSLReplacePushConstantsPass
             loc, dispatchTensorType,
             /*set=*/APInt(64, IREE_HAL_WEBGPU_PARAMS_BIND_GROUP_INDEX),
             /*binding=*/APInt(64, IREE_HAL_WEBGPU_PARAMS_BINDING_INDEX),
    -        IREE::HAL::DescriptorType::StorageBuffer, maxConstantValue, dynamicDims,
    +        IREE::HAL::DescriptorType::UniformBuffer, maxConstantValue, dynamicDims,
             alignmentAttr);
    ```
2. Compile a program that uses push constants for WebGPU, such as [`resnet50_fake_weights.mlir`](https://github.com/iree-org/iree/blob/main/tests/e2e/models/resnet50_fake_weights.mlir):
    ```
    iree-compile \
      --iree-hal-target-backends=webgpu \
      --iree-input-type=mhlo \
      tests/e2e/models/resnet50_fake_weights.mlir \
      -o /dev/null \
      --iree-hal-dump-executable-sources-to=/tmp/resnet50_webgpu/ \
      --iree-hal-dump-executable-intermediates-to=/tmp/resnet50_webgpu/ \
      --iree-hal-dump-executable-binaries-to=/tmp/resnet50_webgpu/
    ```
3. Observe the error:
    ```
    Tint reported 1 error(s) for a SPIR-V program, see diagnostics:
    error: line:38: For Vulkan, an OpTypeStruct variable containing an OpTypeRuntimeArray must be decorated with BufferBlock if it has storage class Uniform.
      %__resource_var_3_0_ = OpVariable %_ptr_Uniform__struct_8 Uniform
    ```   

Here's the .spvasm and .mlir for that resnet50 error: https://gist.github.com/ScottTodd/3308acaf7f54dd9bb0a56e633acb1099

### What component(s) does this issue relate to?

Compiler

### Version information

See above - https://github.com/iree-org/iree/pull/11227 and my one line change to `WGSLReplacePushConstants` are needed to get far enough to see this error. (Note: I'm assuming that both changes there are correct - we might be missing something else, but it's difficult to see more than one error ahead at a time)

### Additional context

Discussion [on Discord here](https://discord.com/channels/689900678990135345/867052513935753277/1043302547068297286). There might be some history here between older/newer versions of the SPIR-V spec and what Tint accepts and compiles to WGSL.

issue.body:
This enables each backend to handle different HAL descriptor types properly by selecting the proper memory space accordingly. Right now the SPIR-V path is plumbed through; various LLVM-based backends are erasing the information to fallback to the previous behavior because lots of LLVM conversion patterns assume numeric memory space, especially memory space 0.

Fixes https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/11183
